# Advokat Pengacara Luthfi Asshiddieqy

> Law office of Luthfi Asshiddieqy, S.H., a licensed Indonesian advocate (advokat / pengacara). Bar number (NIA) 17.01703, member of PERADI (Perhimpunan Advokat Indonesia). Based in Purbalingga, Central Java, and serving the Banyumas Raya area: Purbalingga, Banjarnegara, Purwokerto, Banyumas, and Cilacap. The first consultation is free.

The website is available in four languages, switchable on every page: Indonesian (the primary language), English, Simplified Chinese (简体中文), and Japanese (日本語). Every article below is published in all four languages. The Chinese and Japanese versions are aimed at foreign nationals and investors, including those looking at business or property in the Purbalingga / Banyumas Raya area.

## Practice areas
- Marriage and divorce (Perkawinan & Perceraian)
- Inheritance (Waris)
- Land law (Pertanahan)
- General civil law (Perdata)

## Main pages
- [Home]({{ site.url }}/): the firm, its practice areas, and the service region.
- [About]({{ site.url }}/about/): profile of advocate Luthfi Asshiddieqy.
- [Services]({{ site.url }}/services/): full list of legal services.
- [Contact]({{ site.url }}/contact/): office address, phone, WhatsApp, and map.
- [Journal]({{ site.url }}/blog/): legal articles and practical guides.
- [Terms of Use]({{ site.url }}/terms/): website terms.

## Articles
Each article is also available as plain Markdown for agents: append `.md` to the article URL, without the trailing slash (the English, Simplified-Chinese and Japanese versions each have a `.md` twin too).
